title: Register a regulated water system
summary: Find out that if your business has a regulated water system, you must register it with your local council.
intro:
If your business or commercial premises has a regulated water system, such as a water cooling or warm water system, you’ll need to register this system with your local council.

Water cooling systems are most commonly used in air-conditioning systems and refrigerators. Warm water systems are used to heat and deliver water at a temperature less than 60 degrees Celsius.

You’ll need to complete the registration within one month of occupying the premises or having a new system installed.

Contact your local council to complete the registration.
who_can_apply: Your business or commercial premises has a regulated water system (such as a water cooling or warm water system).
what_you_need: Complete the registration within one month of occupying the premises or having a new system installed.
Contact your local council to complete the registration.
